Requesting Updates in German: B1 Phrase Practice

Ask to be informed about future changes in German. Practise Bescheid geben, auf dem Laufenden and melden with translations and explained B1 answers.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

A request for future information can name the event that should trigger a message: Bitte geben Sie mir Bescheid, sobald … . Halten Sie mich auf dem Laufenden asks for ongoing updates. Falls sich etwas ändert identifies a possible change; sobald identifies the point after which a reply is wanted.

Common mistake to avoid

A request for updates concerns future information, not necessarily a reminder about an unanswered old message. Specify which change or result matters.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Bitte geben Sie mir Bescheid, sobald der Raum feststeht.Please let me know as soon as the room is confirmed.
Worked example 2Halten Sie mich über die weitere Planung auf dem Laufenden.Keep me updated about the further planning.
Worked example 3Falls sich die Uhrzeit ändert, melden Sie sich bitte kurz.If the time changes, please get in touch briefly.
Worked example 4Ich würde gern erfahren, wann die nächsten Informationen vorliegen.I would like to know when the next information will be available.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the update request with the noun, expression, verb or time connector specified by the cue. Use each word-bank item once. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: Bescheid · Laufenden · melden · sobald

Question 1. Bitte geben Sie mir ___, wenn das Ergebnis vorliegt. (notice, in the notification phrase)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: Bescheid

Bescheid geben means informing the person.

Question 2. Halten Sie mich bitte auf dem ___. (up to date, final word)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: Laufenden

Auf dem Laufenden halten asks for ongoing updates.

Question 3. Bitte ___ Sie sich bei einer Änderung. (get in touch)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: melden

Sich melden asks the person to contact the speaker.

Question 4. Informieren Sie mich, ___ der Termin bestätigt ist. (as soon as)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: sobald

Sobald marks the notification trigger in time.
